concerns.text: FR-002 still reads 'scaffold-based split with [deferred] train, [deferred] validation, [deferred] test ratios'. The 80/10/10 ratio is a constitution-mandated constant (Principle VI), not an empirical value to defer, and FR-013 already asserts 80/10/10 — the placeholder makes the split ratios unmeasurable and the spec internally inconsistent. Restore explicit 80/10/10.

Scenario 3 still says 'selected as one of the top-[deferred] highest FQY values of the test set'. The placeholder prevents reproducible instantiation of the test input. Replace with a concrete selection rule (e.g., top-5% highest FQY, or top-N with N fixed).
